description: This PHP file defines the class Zend_Http_Response which models an HTTP response message. It includes properties and methods for parsing, representing, and manipulating HTTP response data such as status codes, headers, body, and utility functions for encoding and decoding transfer methods.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, encapsulating status code, headers, body, and associated utility methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the response object with status code, headers, body, version, and message, validating the input.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Returns true if the response indicates an error (status code 4xx or 5xx).

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Returns true if the response indicates success (status code 1xx or 2xx).

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Returns true if the response indicates a redirection (status code 3xx).

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the response body as a string, decoding transfer encoding and content encoding if necessary.

methods.name: getRawBody
methods.description: Returns the raw response body as transfered on the wire, without decoding.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP version of the response.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the textual message of the response status code.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all response headers.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns a specific header value by name.

methods.name: getHeadersAsString
methods.description: Returns all headers as a formatted string.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the full response (headers + body) as a string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: String representation of the response object, defaults to asString().

methods.name: responseCodeAsText
methods.description: Returns the standard textual description of a response code or all codes if no code is provided.

methods.name: extractCode
methods.description: Extracts response code from a response string.

methods.name: extractMessage
methods.description: Extracts the response message from a response string.

methods.name: extractVersion
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP version from a response string.

methods.name: extractHeaders
methods.description: Extracts headers from a response string into an associative array.

methods.name: extractBody
methods.description: Extracts the body content from a response string.

methods.name: decodeChunkedBody
methods.description: Decodes a chunked transfer-encoded response body.

methods.name: decodeGzip
methods.description: Decodes a gzip-encoded response body.

methods.name: decodeDeflate
methods.description: Decodes a deflate-encoded response body.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a Zend_Http_Response object from a raw response string.
